result.title: Who Is Ego? Scaling Cross-View Camera Wearer Identification and Segmentation beyond Humans
result.summary: A first-person (ego) image reveals what a camera sees, but not who or what carries it. Given a synchronized third-person (exo) image, camera wearer identification asks who is ego: which candidate carries the ego camera? We extend this task beyond humans to robots, vehicles, animals, and drones, and broaden its spatial scope (where is ego) from selecting a provided candidate mask to wearer segmentation with absence prediction and mutual camera localization across ego-exo views. We introduce FindEgo-1M, comprising 1.16M real and simulated ego-exo pairs across 12 wearer types, 17 domains, and 111 test settings. Our approach exploits a geometric relation: the ego camera's projection into the exo image, i.e., the epipole, lies on or near its wearer. We introduce EgoRay-ZS, the first method to turn a frozen feed-forward 3D reconstruction model, VGGT-$Ω$, into a training-free solution for wearer identification and segmentation. Its geometric readout ranks candidate masks or segmentation proposals by angular offset and distance to the ego camera, while the relative pose provides mutual camera directions. We then develop the full EgoRay model through pose-supervised training on FindEgo-1M and label-free test-time adaptation constrained by candidate masks. Without task-specific training, EgoRay-ZS achieves 78.0% identification accuracy on TF2023's original labels, versus 52.9% reported for the dataset-trained PEN. On FindEgo-1M, EgoRay achieves state-of-the-art chance-corrected accuracy of 87.1 and 77.7 on seen and unseen settings. On matched queries, EgoRay also outperforms GPT-6 Astra by 31.6 and 21.3 points on seen and unseen settings, respectively, while running $18\times$ faster. Data, code, and models will be released.

AI.brief_summary: 论文将「谁是 ego」从人类扩展到机器人、车辆、动物和无人机，构建含 116 万对 ego-exo 数据的 FindEgo-1M，并提出利用冻结 3D 重建模型的 EgoRay-ZS 及训练版 EgoRay，通过对极点几何完成穿戴者识别、分割、缺失预测与双向相机定位。
AI.relevance_reason: 该工作不直接研究 LVR 推理机制，但其免训练几何读出、候选分割排序与测试时适配，可能为视觉证据筛选及跨视角空间关系写入内部状态提供方法线索，值得核查迁移可行性。
